items.followUp: How does temperature affect enzyme activity? Give an example.

rubric.why: Identifies the pH at which an enzyme works best and its greatest activity.
rubric.description: Each enzyme has an optimum pH at which its activity is maximum.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking optimum pH with maximum enzyme activity.

rubric.why: Gives a correct example of an enzyme and its preferred pH condition.
rubric.description: For example, pepsin works best in acidic conditions; trypsin works best in alkaline conditions.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming an enzyme and matching it with the correct pH condition.

modelAnswer: Each enzyme has an optimum pH at which its activity is maximum; activity decreases when the pH is above or below this optimum.
For example, pepsin works best in acidic conditions.
